name: healdesk-aya-ad
description: The Aya ad: nine shots cut to an original track, built in Remotion.

scripts.soundtrack: node scripts/soundtrack.mjs public/soundtrack.raw.wav && node scripts/master.mjs public/soundtrack.raw.wav public/soundtrack.wav && rm public/soundtrack.raw.wav
scripts.render: npm run soundtrack && npm run render:hero && npm run render:feed && npm run render:wide
scripts.render:hero: remotion render src/index.ts AyaHero out/aya-hero-9x16.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --x264-preset slow --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --sample-rate 48000
scripts.render:feed: remotion render src/index.ts AyaFeed out/aya-feed-4x5.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --x264-preset slow --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --sample-rate 48000
scripts.render:wide: remotion render src/index.ts AyaWide out/aya-wide-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --x264-preset slow --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --sample-rate 48000
